name: Node Comics MTU CUDA - release draft
onstart:
set +x
set -e
umask 077
if ! printf 'REPLACE_WITH_BOOTSTRAP_SHA256  /opt/node-comics-bootstrap.py\n' | sha256sum --status -c -; then
  bootstrap_tmp=$(mktemp /tmp/node-comics-bootstrap.XXXXXX)
  trap 'rm -f -- "$bootstrap_tmp"' EXIT
  curl --fail --location --silent --show-error --proto '=https' --proto-redir '=https' --retry 5 --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 120 -o "$bootstrap_tmp" REPLACE_WITH_VERSIONED_BOOTSTRAP_URL
  printf 'REPLACE_WITH_BOOTSTRAP_SHA256  %s\n' "$bootstrap_tmp" | sha256sum -c -
  install -m 700 "$bootstrap_tmp" /opt/node-comics-bootstrap.py
  rm -f -- "$bootstrap_tmp"
  trap - EXIT
fi
/usr/bin/python3 /opt/node-comics-bootstrap.py --url REPLACE_WITH_VERSIONED_RUNTIME_URL --sha256 REPLACE_WITH_RUNTIME_SHA256
unset NODE_CONTROL_URL NODE_ID NODE_TOKEN NODE_RESOURCE_ID
exec entrypoint.sh --no-update-portal --no-update-vast
desc: Release draft: fill the published MTU runtime and bootstrap URLs and SHA-256 values before use.
readme: Use SSH launch mode and the supplied on-start script. Fill a NEW independent NODE_ID, NODE_TOKEN and NODE_RESOURCE_ID before renting; center execution_slots=8. Never save real credentials into the template or account-wide variables. Runtime downloads once and verifies SHA-256; subsequent starts reuse it and refuse identity changes. GPU warmup precedes registration; inspect /var/lib/node-comics/state/status.json and center heartbeat. Requires Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64, Python 3.12, CUDA 12.8/cuDNN 9 and NVIDIA CUDA drivers and Qt offscreen system libraries. No application inbound ports. Stop/start preserves state; recycle/destroy without a volume loses it: drain and back up first. No in-place automatic upgrades.
